raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

`Renderer.validate_token_ids` skips the vocab range check when there is no
tokenizer, so with `--skip-tokenizer-init` out-of-range prompt token ids are
not rejected. This runs the check whenever token ids are present, using the
model vocab size as the bound when there is no tokenizer.

No existing PR covers this.

## Test Plan

- pre-commit on the changed files
- New test `test_out_of_vocab_token_skip_tokenizer_init`

## Test Result

- pre-commit passes.
- On CPU with gpt2, id 999999 now raises `Token id 999999 is out of
  vocabulary` with and without `skip_tokenizer_init` (ran with
  `gpu_memory_utilization=0.2`, not enough free RAM for the test default).

Written with the help of a custom AI agent harness.

## Purpose

`Renderer.validate_token_ids` skips the vocab range check when there is no
tokenizer, so with `--skip-tokenizer-init` out-of-range prompt token ids are
not rejected. This runs the check whenever token ids are present, using the
model vocab size as the bound when there is no tokenizer.

No existing PR covers this.

## Test Plan

- New test `test_out_of_vocab_token_skip_tokenizer_init`

## Test Result

- pre-commit passes.
- On CPU with gpt2, id 999999 now raises `Token id 999999 is out of

detail.title: [Bugfix][Core] Validate prompt token ids when skip_tokenizer_init is set

files.patch:
@@ -23,6 +23,20 @@ def test_out_of_vocab_token(vllm_runner):
         runner.llm.generate({"prompt_token_ids": [999999]})
 
 
+def test_out_of_vocab_token_skip_tokenizer_init(vllm_runner):
+    # Without a tokenizer the model vocab size is the only bound; an
+    # out-of-range id must not reach the embedding lookup.
+    with (
+        vllm_runner(
+            "openai-community/gpt2",
+            enforce_eager=True,
+            skip_tokenizer_init=True,
+        ) as runner,
+        pytest.raises(VLLMValidationError, match="out of vocabulary"),
+    ):
+        runner.llm.generate({"prompt_token_ids": [999999]})
+
+
 def test_require_mm_embeds(vllm_runner):
     with (
         vllm_runner(

@@ -455,10 +455,10 @@ def validate_token_ids(
     ) -> None:
         """Raise VLLMValidationError if a token id is out of vocabulary.
 
-        Skipped when the tokenizer is not initialized.
+        Without a tokenizer, the model vocab size is the only bound.
         """
         tokenizer = self.tokenizer
-        if not token_ids or tokenizer is None:
+        if not token_ids:
             return
 
         max_input_id = max(token_ids)
@@ -474,15 +474,17 @@ def validate_token_ids(
 
         # Here we take the max of the two to determine if a token id is
         # truly out-of-vocabulary.
-        model_vocab_size = self.model_config.get_vocab_size()
+        max_token_id = self.model_config.get_vocab_size() - 1
+        if tokenizer is not None:
+            max_token_id = max(tokenizer.max_token_id, max_token_id)
         # A negative id is out of vocabulary just like an over-large one,
         # but is not caught by the upper-bound check below. Reject it here
         # so it is not used as an embedding index downstream.
         if min_input_id < 0:
             raise VLLMValidationError(
                 f"Token id {min_input_id} is out of vocabulary", parameter=parameter
             )
-        if max_input_id > max(tokenizer.max_token_id, model_vocab_size - 1):
+        if max_input_id > max_token_id:
             raise VLLMValidationError(
                 f"Token id {max_input_id} is out of vocabulary", parameter=parameter
             )
